mentions.name: FindSubstack
mentions.description: A newsfeed built from 130k Substack RSS feeds, filtered to posts from the past 24 hours, that surfaces recent Substack writing to help discover writers beyond what recommendation algorithms show.
mentions.problem: Substack content discovery is dominated by algorithmic recommendations, making it hard to find new writers.
mentions.audience: Helps the builder personally discover new Substack writers; built to scratch the author's own itch.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://findsubstack.com

It's a newsfeed constructed from 130k substack RSS feeds but limited to the past 24h.

Its helping me discover writers other than just what the algorithm gives me.
